titulo: Fourteen minutes to wait. Nine to walk
caption:
Fourteen minutes to wait. Nine to walk

The bus sign says fourteen minutes. The walk is nine. She starts walking and the second figure gets up to follow.

Walking takes less than waiting here, and you are already moving when the bus would have shown up.

For whoever walks when the bus is farther than the walk.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A street with a bench on the left and a sign on a pole that says 14 min. A royal blue block figure with white eyes sits on the bench and says just wait for it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes stands beside the sign, then a green sign that says 9 min pops up on the far right. The ink-black one walks to it and the royal blue one stands up, says fine, wait for me, and follows. Both turn happy. The text stays: me walking, not waiting.
